metadata.title: Public water service material summaries for assessed properties

observedPeriod.meaning: Recorded installation dates, not inspection/condition dates.

metadata.key: byRollNumber keys are exact assessment roll-number strings; preserve leading zeros.
metadata.deduplication: The input has 200 assessment records but 199 unique roll numbers. Roll 058525700 appears twice with distinct parcel geometry/recordId; its parcel geometries are combined for the distance calculation, and one pipe summary is provided for the roll.
metadata.matchPolicy: Exact full-address equality takes precedence. If unavailable, an assessment unit prefix can be removed to find a separately labelled building-level candidate. No spatial-nearest matching is used.
metadata.displayPolicy: Use materialSummary with matchLabel. Show every recorded material when multiple records exist. Do not choose the newest or first line as the current material: the source has no current-vs-retired service flag. Candidate materialSummary always includes building candidate.
metadata.distanceMethod: Minimum distance between original service-line geometry and original assessed parcel polygon(s), in approximate metres using a local equirectangular projection at parcel latitude. Multiple parcel records for one roll are combined. Zero means geometries touch/intersect. Distance is supporting context, never verification of a service connection.
metadata.yearPolicy: installedYears includes distinct supplied installation years after 1900. Original installedDate remains in each record; 1900/default values are omitted from the compact year list.
limits: The City dataset describes only the service portion on public property. Private service lines and indoor plumbing are unverified.
No matching record means unavailable information, not absence of a service connection.
Material and installation date do not prove present condition or replacement need.
Other and Unknown material records are counted as unknown rather than mapped to a guessed material.
